item.title: SS United States, a historic ship will be sunk to create an artificial reef
item.description: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Alex Fogg, Natural Resources Chief of Okaloosa County, Florida, about efforts to deliberately sink the SS United States and create an artificial reef in its wreckage.

item.title: Homelessness in the U.S. dropped again. HUD and housing advocates differ on why
item.description: Homelessness in the U.S. has dropped for the second year in a row, two analyses found. But the Trump administration and homeless advocates credit different reasons for the decline.

item.title: One air ambulance service rethinks what it takes to practice medicine in the sky
item.description: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.
